messages:
jamal (support): Urgent — bulk SSO provisioning failed for AcmeCorp trial batch. ~120 accounts invited, ~60 receiving 403 on accept. Customers blocked on activation. Escalating to CS for priority outreach + renewal-risk flag.

maria (cs): On it. Can you paste earliest failing invite IDs and any common error? Which sub-orgs/customers are highest risk?

jamal (support): Error from invites svc:
```json
{"invite_id":"inv_9A1","status":403,"reason":"token_mismatch"}
```
Most affected across AcmeCorp sub-orgs: sales, onboarding, payroll. Trials end in ~9 days for many.

zack (eng): Looking. Hypothesis: token signer rotated during migration. Quick mitigation: reissue invites with `POST /v1/invites/reissue` for affected invite ids.
CLI:
```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $API" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invites/reissue -d '{"invite_ids":["inv_9A1","inv_9B2"]}'
```
I can run this if you give the list.

maria (cs): Please reissue for the ~60 failing ASAP. We'll call top 10 accounts and email the rest. Drafting comms now.

olivia (pm): Comms plan suggestion:
- 1h: Reissue invites + monitor accept rate
- 2h: Outbound call to top 10 P0 accounts (CS leads: @maria)
- 4h: Team update to account execs + renewal ops
- Template: short apology, action taken, CTA to re-accept invite
I'll attach template in a sec.

jamal (support): Uploaded CSV with failing invite_ids: https://files.redwood/links/acc123-invites.csv
Reissue in next 30m pls.

zack (eng): Reissue job queued, running now. I'll post progress here. ETA 25m.

deploy-bot: Job reissue-invites-5132109876 started by zack (eng). 0/60 done.

zack (eng): 15/60 done. 403s stopped for jobs processed so far. Accept rate going up.

maria (cs): I'll send the email template now and start outreach. Email snippet:
"Hi <Name>, quick heads up — we had an issue with invites; we've reissued your invite. Please check your inbox and re-accept by following this link: <link>. We're on standby to help. -Maria, Redwood CS"
Assigning tasks: @taylor (csm) call list A; @maria follow top 5 escalations; @zack monitor logs.

taylor (csm): On calls. ping me with the list.

zack (eng): Reissue finished. 60/60. Monitor shows normal accepts; returning 200 for accept events. Rolling back temporary signer rotation.

maria (cs): Great. Marking as resolved for now but flagging renewal risk: AcmeCorp trial ends in 9 days, lost trust signal. Need coordinated follow-up: 3-touch campaign + check-in call with account execs. I'll create renewal watch ticket.

olivia (pm): Agreed. Add postmortem and ask infra to add signing-key-migration playbook.

jamal (support): TL;DR: 60 invites failed due to signer rotation; reissue done; CS outbound in progress; renewal watch created. I'll update ticket with timeline.

maria (cs): Thanks all :thumbsup: Please add reaction when you complete assigned action.
